data.narrative:
Swift Beat, a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Eric Schmidt, has raised $50M+ to date. The applicable peer universe comprises 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $50M raised as a proxy for post-money value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression, implying a $100M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence at $4.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M. The median of this cohort is $400M, establishing the high end of the range but reflecting material dispersion (min $125M, max $4.0B).

The triangulated analysis produces a low of $85M, median of $250M, and high of $460M. The $250M midpoint balances the conservative stage-progression result against peer-median data while acknowledging significant uncertainty inherent in a sector characterized by substantial valuation variance and an early-stage target with limited operational history. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set given the $4.0B outlier, and whether Swift Beat's technology and market position align more closely with the $125M or $400M tier of comparables.
